coordinateReferenceSystem.note: NOT WGS84. [x, y] in canonical game units, origin LOWER-LEFT, +x right, +y UP. This is the single coordinate space shared by the LevelEditor, the Simulator and the game, and by the stored level geometry. Nothing rescales: use these numbers verbatim. Map artwork is exactly 2868x2064 in this same space.

metadata.title: Siege of Charleston, 1780 - the Neck
metadata.designModel: Kingdom Rush: Frontiers stage 9 'Lost Jungle' (road terminals on all four edges knitting through a central junction web), with Forsaken Valley's slot density and Icewind Pass's folded-serpentine coverage.

designNotes.slotPlacement: 6 slots meet every strict clearance (>=139.3 to road centerline, pad clear of road). 7 'verge' slots hug the roadside with the virtual footprint overlapping the road edge by up to 30px (Kingdom Rush convention; shipped Charleston uses d 80-176, median 136, with overlaps to 59px). 4 slots encroach the HUD-corner menu-outset bands by design necessity - 17 slots plus 40% coverage cannot fit inside the strict menu-safe area (packing ceiling is ~13); shipped Charleston makes the same trade on slots 7/10/17. Every slot pad keeps >=8px clearance from the HUD occlusion rects themselves, stays inside the menu-safe rect proper, and no two pads overlap. roadInRangeAtL1 and emphasis are computed at the DB's ranged L1 tower range of 180 (towers.sql); emphasis weights road length by how many of the six lanes share it.
designNotes.portMarkers: Entrance/exit markers sit 64 units inside the play edge ON the path centerline; path polylines run ~150 units past the play edge into the bleed so enemies walk on/off runtimeCanvas (Charleston convention). Marker-to-mouth distances are ~214, inside the sync tool's pathWidth*2 matching radius.

properties.name: Play area
properties.note: The 1920 x 1080 gameplay viewport in canonical map units.

properties.name: Ashley River
properties.artNote: Broad tidal river filling the west bleed; the west road arrives at a ferry landing on its bank.

properties.name: Cooper River
properties.artNote: Tidal river in the northeast bleed; the east road runs down to wharves on its bank.

properties.name: Spring creek
properties.artNote: Small creek rising at the mill hairpin's spring and winding southwest into the Ashley marsh.

properties.name: Ashley marsh
properties.artNote: Impassable tidal marsh across the southwest low ground - the reason no road crosses this corner.

properties.name: Live-oak wood
properties.artNote: Dense live-oak and palmetto mass rounding the northwest corner; hides the map edge.

properties.name: Pine stand
properties.artNote: Pine stand rounding the northeast corner between the top road and the Cooper.

properties.name: Neck farms
properties.artNote: Fenced farm plots in the north-central meadow; tower pads here sit in field corners.

properties.name: Siege parallel
properties.historical: The British approached Charleston in April 1780 by formal siege, digging parallels across the Neck.
properties.artNote: Zig-zag earthwork and gabions at the wood edge, hinting at the besiegers' second parallel.

properties.name: The Hornwork
properties.historical: A brick hornwork straddled the town gate on the Charleston Neck - the city's main landward defense in 1780.
properties.artNote: Brick gate citadel below the bottom exit; the south road passes through its gate into town.

properties.name: Charleston
properties.artNote: Town rooftops and St. Michael's steeple filling the south bleed - what the defense is protecting.

properties.name: Ashley Ferry Road
properties.artNote: Long west lane: ferry landing, mill hairpin, river road along the low fields, past the Hornwork glacis to the city gate.

properties.name: Broad Path
properties.artNote: The main Neck highway: straight-running mid road from the Ashley ferry across the crossroads to the Cooper wharves.

properties.name: King Street Road
properties.artNote: North entrance road diving straight down the central lane through the crossroads to the city gate.

properties.name: Cooper River Road
properties.artNote: North road swinging east along the high ground, descending the shore bluff to the Cooper wharves.

properties.name: Ropewalk Lane
properties.artNote: North road along the top fields, down the central lane, then east around the ropewalk loop to the city gate.

properties.name: Wharf Road
properties.artNote: West lane along the low fields, around the ropewalk loop and up the shore to the wharves.

properties.name: Entrance 0
properties.artNote: Ashley ferry landing - the west road climbs from the river bank.

properties.name: Entrance 1
properties.artNote: The Neck road from the north - main landward approach.

properties.name: Exit 0
properties.artNote: The town gate through the Hornwork - enemies exiting here enter the city.

properties.name: Exit 1
properties.artNote: Cooper River wharves - enemies exiting here reach the waterfront.
